generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five financial years i.e. 2021-22, 202223, 2023-24, 2024-25 2025-26 achieved in at least Three (03) financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.14.50 Lakh.

Each Tenderer in its name should have successfully completed or substantially completed similar works during last five (05) years either of the followingi)One (1) similar work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.24.17 Lakh (Excl GST)ii)Two (2) similar works costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.19.34 Lakh (Excl GST)iii)Three (3) similar works costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.14.50 Lakh (Excl GST)

In case of any errors in General conditions of Eligibility, Tender document Terms and conditions will be Final and applicable

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Special Track Maintenance works in Reach-1 Section (BYPH-CBPK)

itemList.description:
Gauge Attention work by replacing the damaged/Worn-out Normal/Eccentric bushes with appropriate N/Eccentric bushes on outer/inner rail to bring the gauge value with in tolerance limit Including Labour, tools and plants, transportation and complete as per the direction of Engineer in-charge.
The Eccentric bushes will be supplied by BMRC.

Lifting of rail in track for the works of shifting baseplates for sheared anchor bolts or replacement of pads/Baseplates or other similar works including Labours, machineries, consumables etc. except Track spares will be provided by BMRCL

Removal of existing Broken or Sheared Anchor bolts by core cutting and re-fixing of New Anchor Bolts by Maintaining proper Verticality and Epoxy grouting material including Labour, Material, Machineries, Fuel and Transportation etc. As per the Instruction of BMRCL Engineer In-charge.
Material: Epoxy materila suitable for setting in 2 to 2.5hrs
Anchor Bolt Supply under BMRCL Scope.

Replacement of Pads below CMS Crossing by 
a.Shifting of Tools & machineries from Platform to site & back 
b. Loosening of Fastenings 
c. Lifting by Mechanical jack operation and Removal of Old Pads & placement of New Pads including minor adjustment with shim pads 
d.Tightening of Fastenings 

Supply of Pads under BMRCL scope.
